blocks.text: Ten of the fourteen material risks sit outside Wesgro's control, so the mitigation for most of them is early warning and a route to the tier that can act.

Likelihood and impact are Letsema's assessment on a three-point scale, from the evidence cited in each row. Steerco reviews the register each quarter and the owner reports on any risk rated high on both.

blocks.caption: Fourteen risks could move the plan off its path, and the one rated high on both measures concerns the national air regime.
blocks.source: Letsema assessment. Evidence: Current State Diagnostic, Dec 2025 (Diag); Demand-Side Analysis, Jun 2026 (DSA); Stakeholder Insights Report, Mar 2026 (SIR); Infrastructure Report, Jul 2026 (IR); SME and Community Inclusion Plan, Sep 2026 (SCIP); Inception Report, Nov 2025 (Inc).
